Note

First time at Rock and Roll Circus and it delivered on both the rock and the circus.

Wunderhorse and Gurriers were great as expected. Bleech 9:3 were good but would be a lot better at a smaller venue. Very surprised by Westside Cowboy and Fatdog, I've had both their albums on repeat since. And the less said about Baxter Dury the better..

29 Nov 2025
Note

I love Mexican food and living in London I am spoilt for Mexican restaurants. Michelin Mexican restaurants, Mexican street vendors, and everything in between.

I have been to 5 of the 'in-between' places and here is my ranking:

  1. Corrochios - Great atmosphere, authentic food
  2. La Chingada - Our local, super chilled
  3. Tacos El Pastor - Stylish, pricey
  4. Jalisco - Unmatched burritos
  5. Mestizo - Upmarket, creative menu

19 Nov 2025
Note

An issue I've had switching to Aerospace is that typing # (on a mac) causes me to switch to workspace 3:

A fix I came across was to define an empty binding mode. When switching to a new binding mode, all the previous bindings are disabled in favour of the new bindings, allowing me to type #.

To get this working I mapped Option + Backspace in the main and new mode to toggle between them:

I think this is currently the best solution but it would be nice to map the left and right modifier keys separately.
